statement: With Steam closed, four-byte C5 basis stimuli at raw value 25 produced no visible change with override disabled. Setting 37 initially read 0; command 87 accepted a write of 1, and command 89 then read 1. This enabled owner-observed red, green, blue and white for byte positions 0 through 3 respectively. Zeroing the channels produced off between enabled trials. Restoring setting 37 to 0 returned normal wired green, confirmed by the owner. All selected captured control completions had status 0. E9 declared length 4 in a 63-byte numbered reply and returned four zeros even during visibly active stimuli. Retain RGBW intent separately from override and readback. Brightness calibration and persistence are not established.

applicability.revision: Physical direct-wired 1302; device-version marker 0404 checked before LED work
applicability.firmware: Live build attribute not re-read in these colour sessions
applicability.scope: Owner-supervised wired RGBW basis values 25 and 0, plus mixing with white 10, with override values 0 and 1. No wireless, persistence, calibrated colour or complete-range validation.
